error_taxonomy.meaning: A unary state-API request was cancelled.
An observe resume cursor fell outside the WAL retention window.
The server logged an unexpected state-API failure and returned a generic fault.
The change subscription named a missing target.
The tree is busy under storage back-pressure and the caller should back off.
The caller has no valid active tenant or may not act as the asserted tenant.
The gRPC authorization check was cancelled.
The coarse gRPC authorizer denied the call before it reached the facade.
